name: Smoke Ring
author: E. T. Carter
description: Rings of smoke blown one after another from a vent on a slim post on a dark studio floor. Each rises, widens and leans, turning in on itself like a real vortex ring: two arms of smoke spiral in to a glowing core, streaked along the flow, the edge fraying and shedding until the ring thins away and the next comes up. The cores glow in the theme; the smoke round them is grey, lit by the spot and shadowed by itself.

sculpture.label: Rings of smoke rising one after another from a vent, each rolling in on itself round a glowing core, fraying at the edge until it thins away.

params.label: Roll
params.effect: How fast the ring rolls in on itself; 0 freezes the wisps.

params.label: Density
params.effect: How thick the smoke is, from a faint wisp to a dense glowing ring.

params.label: Turn
params.effect: Turntable speed: 1 is one turn a minute, swinging the lean of the rings round so the hole faces every side; 0 holds it.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer orbits the camera round the piece; 0 ignores the mouse.
